## How to get & run it

You need R (≥ 4.5) and RStudio.

```r
usethis::use_course(
  "https://github.com/CorradoLanera/mlt-overview/releases/latest/download/mlt-r-basic.zip"
)
```

The download is a **bundle of per-step projects**, not a single project. Open the step you are
on — start with `steps/00-setup/00-setup.Rproj`. At `00-setup` you run `renv::init()` from scratch
(that is the first lesson); from `01-import` on, opening a step's `.Rproj` auto-activates its
`renv` — then `renv::restore()` for the pinned packages.
